title: Queue
summary: First in, first out, like the line at a ticket counter.

viz.hello: This queue has room for {n} values. front = {front} and count = {count}. Try enqueue, dequeue or peek.
viz.enqueued: enqueue({value}): the next free box is ({front} + {count}) % {n} = {index}, so {value} went there. count is now {newCount}.
viz.enqueueWrapped: The rear went past the last box, so % wrapped it around to box {index}.
viz.dequeued: dequeue(): took {value} from box {index}. front moved to {front}, and count is now {count}.
viz.dequeueWrapped: front went past the last box, so % wrapped it around to box 0.
viz.peeked: peek(): the front value is {value}, in box {index}. Nothing moved.
viz.full: enqueue({value}): count = {n}, so every box is in use. The queue is full.
viz.empty: The queue is empty (count = 0), so there is nothing to take.
viz.ghost: Faded numbers are old values. They stay in their box until an enqueue writes over them.
viz.resetDone: Started again with an empty queue: front = 0 and count = 0.
